title: org.ligatureprotocol.capability
description: DRAFT. A manifest: the full list of capabilities a device currently offers. A later manifest from the same peer replaces this one; when the session ends every capability in it is withdrawn. The domain ligatureprotocol.org is a placeholder; it is not yet registered.

typeName.description: A reverse-DNS type name such as org.ligatureprotocol.capability.clipboard.

scope.description: Whether the capability belongs to a person's session on the device (user) or to the device itself (device). Spec chapter 10.

family.description: The initial capability families. Each will receive its own schema. share is the ad-hoc, AirDrop-like push of text, links or files to a chosen device, accepted per item (spec chapter 05 section 3a).

descriptor.description: One capability a device offers right now. The offering principal or binding is the sender of the manifest.

version.description: Version of the type's operation set this device implements.

label.description: Optional human-readable label, such as the name of a display.

params.description: Type-specific parameters; the schema is defined by the capability type's own schema.
